tool.name: @BINARY@
tool.description: creates a per-distance p-value threshold file for hicDetectLoops

param.label: Threshold value
param.help: Value written for every relative distance. It can be edited per distance in the resulting file afterwards.

param.name: upstream
param.label: Upstream end of the range (bp)
param.help: Distance upstream of the reference point, given as a negative number or zero. A positive value is interpreted as negative.

param.label: Resolution (bp)
param.help: Bin size in bases; one row is written per bin over the range.

tool.help:
Threshold file creation =======================
**hicCreateThresholdFile** writes a tab separated file with one threshold value per relative genomic distance. The file can be given to **hicDetectLoops** as *p-value preselection* instead of a single value, which allows a different candidate p-value threshold per distance.
_________________
Usage -----
The tool writes the same *Threshold value* for every distance from the upstream to the downstream end of the range, in steps of *Resolution*; both ends are included. To use different thresholds for some distances, edit the values in the second column of the output.
_________________
Output ------
Two header lines starting with ``#``, followed by one row per distance: the relative distance in bp and the threshold value.
_________________
For more information about HiCExplorer please consider our documentation on readthedocs.io_.
.. _readthedocs.io: http://hicexplorer.readthedocs.io/en/latest/index.html
